description: This Java source file defines the `LoanReAmortizationIntegrationTest` class, which contains multiple JUnit test methods for testing loan re-amortization features within the Apache Fineract project. The class extends `BaseLoanIntegrationTest` and includes methods to test various scenarios such as re-amortizing loans, undoing re-amortizations, handling backdated repayments, partial payments, multiple disbursals, and related transaction manipulations. The file is central to the integration testing of the loan re-amortization functionality, including schedule verification, transaction validation, and disbursement management.

classes.name: LoanReAmortizationIntegrationTest
classes.description: This class contains comprehensive integration tests for loan re-amortization features, designed to validate schedule updates, transaction correctness, and disbursement handling in the Apache Fineract system. It includes multiple test methods covering scenarios like standard re-amortizations, undoing re-amortizations, partial repayments, backdating, multiple disbursals, and more to ensure the robustness of loan schedule adjustments.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithMultiDisbursalAndRepaymentsWithEnableDownPayment
methods.description: Creates a loan product with multiple disbursals, repayment options, and optional downpayment features for testing various complex loan scenarios.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithMultiDisbursalAndRepaymentsWithEnableDownPayment

methods.name: reAmortizeLoanRepaymentScheduleTest
methods.description: Validates re-amortization process especially when scheduled after repayment modifications and business date changes.
